Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mirna usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful, calming and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Mirna takes on a deeper spiritual meaning. It symbolizes the peaceful and calming presence of God, which can be a source of comfort and strength in times of need. The name brings to mind the idea of the miraculous and the wondrous things that God can do in our lives. It is a reminder that even in the midst of worldly troubles, we can find solace and amazement in the wonders of God's creation and love. Thus, Mirna is not just a beautiful and exotic name, but also a spiritual reminder of the peaceful and calming presence of God in our lives.
